narration: 捜索隊は3班に分かれ、山へ入ります。
asset_type: キャラアニメーション
scene: 3本に分かれる山道の手前で、3班がそれぞれの道へ向かう。班の先頭に立つハンター（CHAR-05・CHAR-09）と消防署員の3人。

fences.label: キャラプロンプト（1:1）:
fences.text: (CHAR-05 再利用) [Generic group] Cute cartoon character design, thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, large expressive eyes, children's animation style. Three full-body Japanese search-team leaders, each heading off a different way, all faces clearly visible. Left to right: 1) (CHAR-05 再利用) a Japanese local hunter in his 60s with short grey hair and a grey stubble, an orange cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, a small backpack, a rifle slung on his back pointing upward, facing the viewer and pointing to his right with his arm fully outstretched, eyebrows driven down hard, mouth wide open shouting an order, sweat on his temple; 2) (CHAR-09 再利用) a Japanese young hunter in his 30s with short black hair, a dark green cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, a rifle slung on his back pointing upward, facing the viewer and pointing straight up ahead with one hand, eyes wide and fierce, mouth open; 3) a Japanese firefighter in his 40s, stocky, a plain navy work uniform and a white helmet, facing the viewer and pointing to his left, eyebrows pulled together, jaw tight, a bead of sweat on his brow. All three are tense and determined, NOT calm, NOT smiling. Every person is a distinct individual, no two dressed alike. NO TWO OF THEM SHARE A FACE, A HAIRSTYLE OR AN OUTFIT. No two of them are the same height. No lettering, no badge, no logo, no emblem anywhere. Each figure has a very large head about one third of the total height, a short compact torso and short stubby arms and legs, roughly three heads tall. Do NOT draw them with realistic adult proportions — not four, five, six or seven heads tall. Full body. Transparent background, real alpha transparency. 1:1 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.

fences.text: A forest trail that splits into three separate paths leading up into the hills near Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in mid-April early spring: bare and budding deciduous trees, low green bamboo grass between the paths, brown leaf litter, No snow anywhere, no snow patches, no frost, no ice, no winter. Framed from adult eye height about four metres back, the three paths fanning out in the upper half, the lower middle of the frame left as clear open space. Tense, purposeful mood, soft overcast light, muted natural tones. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style. 16:9 aspect ratio. No people, no figures, no humans visible. Empty landscape only. Generate 1 image.

directions: → 編集者指示: 背景・キャラとも新規。3人を中央下に置き、指さす腕を小さく動かす（動画は作らない）。3本の道に1〜3の番号を編集で置く。中央に「3班に分かれる」を白字で表示し、「3班」だけ赤字。
